notablePrerequisites:
You control a nonlegendary artifact creature with mana value eight or greater.
Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Slobad.
description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary artifact creature with mana value eight or greater with haste.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature token, adding at least eight {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
The artifact creature token dies, triggering Slobad, untapping Slobad.
Repeat.
